The '''End of Wandering''' is a [[Point of Interest]] located in {{Location|Tethys' Deep}}.

==Overview==
The End of Wandering is located deep within the [[Tethys System]],<ref name="ARTICLE" /> available to enter through the [[Greenhouse]] or [[Shorekeeper]]'s garden in [[Eidoscope]]. The End of Wandering is exclusively accessible by [[Rover]] and Shorekeeper only, and cannot be entered until completing {{Quest|Beyond the Shore's End}}.

The End of Wandering is unique, acting like a [[Sonoro Sphere]] in regards to it not having a place on the map, instead blacking it out when entered.
